mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS today_order_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付', '已完成') AND create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)), 0) AS today_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = '待支付') AS pending_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ski_resort) AS resort_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facility WHERE status = '正常') AS normal_facility_count, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) FROM feedback WHERE rating IS NOT NULL), 0) AS average_rating
SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders GROUP BY order_type

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status IN ('已支付', '已完成') AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date
